title: Frame Toby
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Toby returns to the office, much to Michael's dismay, who tries unsuccessfully to have him removed. Michael and Dwight hatch a plan to frame Toby for drug dealing, leading to a police investigation that ultimately reveals the tip was false. Meanwhile, Jim surprises Pam by buying a house for them, and Ryan breaks up with Kelly before leaving for a trip to Thailand.
